description: First-ever compile of TESTKIT (src/qrpglesrc/testkit.sqlrpgle, *SRVPGM: testInit/assertEqualsChar/assertEqualsNum/assertTrue) and the two 08-04 test-case programs that exercise it (solutions/08-04/tstjucsrv.rpgle: 10 design-doc cases + 1 deliberately-failing case 00; solutions/08-04/tstzaisrv.rpgle: 5 boundary cases). None of these three files has been compiled or run before this connection - see each source file's own header for the specific unconfirmed design points this connection is meant to settle: (1) whether EXEC SQL SET OPTION is valid sitting at module scope, outside every dcl-proc, in a NOMAIN module (testkit.sqlrpgle's own header); (2) whether callStackCtr 2 on the QMHSNDPM(*ESCAPE) call in raiseFail() actually reaches TSTJUCSRV/TSTZAISRV's own MONITOR blocks, and specifically whether execution really continues past a failed assertion to the NEXT statement (settled by case 00 in tstjucsrv.rpgle, a deliberately-wrong assertEqualsNum('00-DELIBERATE-FAIL-DEMO', 999, countCustOrders('C00001')) - if case 01 still logs its own TESTRES row afterward, MONITOR let execution continue as designed); (3) whether testInit()'s unqualified CREATE TABLE lands in <USER>1 (CURLIB, per docs/probes.md's part07-04-actgrp-cl RTVJOBA finding) instead of &LIB - the CHGCURLIB1 step below is the fix, and this manifest's TESTRES collect step (reading from &LIB, never <USER>1) is itself the check: if CHGCURLIB1 were somehow ineffective, that collect would simply find no such table, not silently read the wrong one; (4) whether OVRDBF FILE(ZAIKOM) TOFILE(QTEMP/ZAIKOM), issued at this wrapper's own call level before CALLing TSTZAISRV, actually redirects ZAISRV's own internal file open (ZAISRV is ACTGRP(*CALLER), activating into TSTZAISRV's own activation - see tstzaisrv.rpgle's own header for why this must happen before ZAISRV's module first activates, not just before TSTZAISRV's mainline starts). ADVISOR-FLAGGED GAP (fixed here): part06-p43-lockdiag's own OVRDBF (WAITRCD) reached T643CHK only because T643CHK shared the CL wrapper's own default activation group (both *YES/*PGM, confirmed by that connection's own compile listing, docs/probes.md) - TSTZAISRV is compiled ACTGRP(*NEW), a DIFFERENT activation group, so whether a default-OVRSCOPE(*CALLLVL) override crosses that boundary is NOT something P43 tested. OVRSCOPE(*JOB) is added to OVRZAIKOM below specifically to sidestep this question (job-wide scope, not call-level-scoped) rather than assume the P43 result generalizes. QTEMP/ZAIKOM is seeded with ZASU=7 for P00001 specifically BECAUSE this repo's real db/data/load_v1.sql seeds P00001's real ZASU to 45 (part08-design-v1.md section 0.7) - if the boundary-case results in TESTRES for P00001 show a starting quantity of 7 (not 45 or some other value), that alone confirms ZAISRV really opened the QTEMP copy, not the shared one. The shared-zaikom-check collect step (reading &LIB/ZAIKOM directly, bypassing the override entirely since collect steps run as a separate db2 call) is the direct, independent confirmation: it should read 45 (db/data/load_v1.sql's seed, assuming no other writer has touched it since the last TXRESET) regardless of what TESTRES shows - if it reads anything else, the override did NOT take effect and the shared table was touched; this manifest never runs TXRESET, so that would need to be run as a separate, manual follow-up before any other lesson's manifest touches ZAIKOM again. CHGCURLIB1 uses the same pattern as verify/part07-04-actgrp-cl/manifest.json's own CHGCURLIB1 step. TESTKITBD (new binding directory, shared by both test-case programs) uses the same CHKOBJ+conditional-CRTBNDDIR+ADDBNDDIRE idiom as verify/part07-05-checkpoint/manifest.json's CPZAISBD step (already fixed there for the MONMSG-stacking trap part08-design-v1.md section 8 item 9 documents - this manifest's own CPTESTKITBD step copies that fixed 3-line form exactly, with no extra inline MONMSG after ADDBNDDIRE). Prerequisite: JUCSRV (part07-0203-srvpgm) and ZAISRV (part07-05-checkpoint) must already exist in &LIB.

steps.label: CPTESTKITM
steps.cmd: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&LIB/TESTKIT) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(TESTKIT) OBJTYPE(*MODULE) COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CPTESTKITS
steps.cmd: CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/TESTKIT) MODULE(&LIB/TESTKIT) EXPORT(*SRCFILE) SRCFILE(&LIB/QSRVSRC) SRCMBR(TESTKIT) ACTGRP(*CALLER) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPTESTKITBD
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/TESTKITBD) OBJTYPE(*BNDDIR)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTBNDDIR BNDDIR(&LIB/TESTKITBD))
ADDBNDDIRE BNDDIR(&LIB/TESTKITBD) OBJ((*LIBL/TESTKIT *SRVPGM))

steps.label: CPTSTJUCSRV
steps.cmd: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/TSTJUCSRV) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(TSTJUCSRV) DFTACTGRP(*NO) ACTGRP(*NEW) BNDDIR((*LIBL/JUCSRVBD) (*LIBL/TESTKITBD)) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPTSTZAISRV
steps.cmd: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/TSTZAISRV) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(TSTZAISRV) DFTACTGRP(*NO) ACTGRP(*NEW) BNDDIR((*LIBL/ZAISRVBD) (*LIBL/TESTKITBD)) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: QTEMPZAIKOM
steps.cmd: CRTDUPOBJ OBJ(ZAIKOM) FROMLIB(&LIB) OBJTYPE(*FILE) TOLIB(QTEMP) DATA(*YES)

steps.label: SEEDQTEMP
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('UPDATE QTEMP/ZAIKOM SET ZASU = 7 WHERE ZASHO = ''P00001''') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.sql: SELECT SEQ, TESTNM, EXPECTED, ACTUAL, RESULT FROM &LIB/TESTRES ORDER BY SEQ
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN RESULT = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PASS_CNT FROM &LIB/TESTRES
SELECT ZASHO, ZASU FROM &LIB/ZAIKOM WHERE ZASHO = 'P00001'
